title: OpenClaw Gateway AAA Suite Task Manifest

milestones.name: AAA Core Architecture & Storage Layer
milestones.description: Establish unified storage contracts, in-memory LRU and Redis distributed adapters, atomic Lua scripts, and multi-tenant database migrations.

tasks.name: Multi-Tenant Database Migrations
tasks.description: Create PostgreSQL and SQLite compatible DDL migrations for organizations, workspaces, roles, permissions, and hashed key columns.
implementationSteps: Draft tenant and membership tables with UUID primary keys and cascading foreign keys.
Draft roles, permissions, and role_permissions tables pre-seeded with enterprise standard roles.
Draft alter table statements for gateway_keys to add key_prefix, secret_hash, and policy constraints.
Ensure full ANSI SQL compatibility across SQLite DatabaseSync and PostgreSQL/Supabase.
acceptanceCriteria: SQL files parse cleanly without syntax errors.
Tables can be bootstrapped in SQLite and applied cleanly to PostgreSQL.
Zero data loss on existing request_logs or gateway_keys tables.

tasks.name: Unified Storage Backend Contract & Types
tasks.description: Define TypeScript interface AAAStorageBackend covering key caching, sliding window rate limits, concurrency slots, quota holds, and audit queueing.
implementationSteps: Define RateLimitResult, HashedKeyData, AuthIdentity, AuthContext, Policy, and AuditEvent contracts.
Define AAAStorageBackend lifecycle methods (init, close).
Define atomic rate limit, concurrency, and quota contract signatures.
Export all contracts through backend/src/aaa/index.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: Interface signatures strictly match PROJECT.md specifications.
TypeScript compiler passes with strict type checking enabled.

tasks.name: In-Memory Storage Adapter
tasks.description: Implement zero-dependency MemoryStorageBackend using LRU cache, timestamp sliding arrays, and quota balance maps.
implementationSteps: Implement in-memory Map with TTL eviction for getHashedKey / setHashedKey.
Implement sliding-window rate limit evaluator using timestamped millisecond logs.
Implement active concurrency slot counters with acquire/release methods.
Implement quota reservation wallet tracking reserved and settled balances in USD.
Implement in-memory audit event queue with batch flush.
acceptanceCriteria: All AAAStorageBackend interface methods are genuinely implemented.
Rate limit sliding window resets accurately after windowSeconds.
Concurrency slot limits reject when active count equals maxConcurrent.
Quota reservation correctly decrements available balance and settles post-execution.

tasks.name: Redis Storage Adapter & Lua Scripts
tasks.description: Implement high-throughput RedisStorageBackend using atomic Lua scripts for sliding-window rate limiting and quota holds.
implementationSteps: Write sliding_window.lua using Redis sorted sets (ZADD, ZREMRANGEBYSCORE, ZCARD, EXPIRE).
Write quota_reserve.lua performing atomic balance check and reservation decrement.
Implement RedisStorageBackend invoking loaded Lua scripts via SHA.
Add connection retry logic, prefix namespacing, and graceful shutdown.
acceptanceCriteria: Lua scripts execute atomically without race conditions under concurrency.
Rate limit evaluation completes in single round-trip.
Gracefully handles Redis connection errors with informative logs.

milestones.name: Enterprise Authentication (AuthN) Suite
milestones.description: Scaffold and implement SHA-256 hashed API keys, plaintext migration utility, federated OIDC/OAuth2 verifier, mTLS extractor, and unified authnMiddleware.

tasks.name: Hashed API Key Manager
tasks.description: Build secure key generation (oc_<env>_<id>_<secret>), SHA-256 hash validation, timingSafeEqual comparison, and key rotation.
implementationSteps: Implement generateApiKey(tenantId, projectId, name, env, options) returning plaintext key once.
Implement verifyApiKey(token) parsing prefix, looking up hash, and validating via crypto.timingSafeEqual.
Implement rotateApiKey(keyId, gracePeriodDays) supporting secondary key grace periods.
Integrate caching via AAAStorageBackend.
acceptanceCriteria: Plaintext secret is never stored in DB or logs.
Validation succeeds with valid key and fails with invalid/revoked/expired keys.
Constant-time comparison protects against timing attacks.

tasks.name: Plaintext Key In-Place Migration Utility
tasks.description: Utility to migrate existing legacy plaintext gateway_keys into hashed format without disrupting running client connections.
implementationSteps: Scan legacy gateway_keys where secret_hash IS NULL.
Generate deterministic key_prefix and secret_hash for each existing key.
Update record in transaction while retaining backwards compatibility during rollout.
Provide CLI dry-run and apply modes.
acceptanceCriteria: All existing gateway keys receive valid prefix and SHA-256 hash.
No client disconnection occurs during migration rollout.

tasks.name: Federated OIDC & JWT Verifier
tasks.description: Dynamic JWKS discovery, RS256/ES256 verification, and claims mapping for enterprise IdPs (Okta, Keycloak, Azure AD).
implementationSteps: Fetch and cache .well-known/openid-configuration and jwks.json.
Verify JWT signatures against cached public keys with auto-refresh on unknown kid.
Validate standard claims (iss, aud, exp, nbf).
Extract tenant, role, and permission scopes into AuthIdentity.
acceptanceCriteria: Accurately validates valid OIDC tokens and rejects expired or tampered signatures.
Caches JWKS keys with configurable TTL.

tasks.name: Mutual TLS (mTLS) Certificate Extractor
tasks.description: Extract and validate client TLS certificates from direct TLS sockets or reverse-proxy ingress headers (XFCC / X-Client-Cert).
implementationSteps: Parse client certificate from Node TLS socket or RFC-compliant XFCC headers.
Extract Subject CN, Subject SANs, and SHA-256 fingerprint.
Match certificate fingerprint against tenant service account whitelist.
Inject mTLSCertificate metadata into request AuthContext.
acceptanceCriteria: Correctly extracts SAN/CN from simulated and real client certificates.
Rejects untrusted or mismatched certificates when mTLS mode is enforced.

tasks.name: Unified AuthN Middleware
tasks.description: Hono middleware evaluating API keys, OIDC Bearer tokens, and mTLS certs to bind verified AuthContext to c.set('authContext').
implementationSteps: Extract credential from Authorization Bearer, x-api-key, or anthropic-api-key.
Dispatch to appropriate authenticator strategy.
Construct unified AuthContext and attach to Hono context.
Return standardized 401 Unauthorized JSON error on authentication failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Successfully authenticates API key, OIDC token, and mTLS credentials.
Injects verified AuthContext available to downstream middlewares.

milestones.name: Dynamic Authorization (AuthZ) & Governance
milestones.description: Implement RBAC permissions matrix, contextual ABAC policy engine, model governance parameter clamps, and unified authzMiddleware.

tasks.name: RBAC Roles & Permissions Taxonomy
tasks.description: Define enterprise role hierarchy (SuperAdmin, OrgAdmin, ProjectAdmin, Developer, Auditor) and granular action scopes.
implementationSteps: Define permission constants (llm:chat:invoke, keys:create, audit:read, etc.).
Define built-in role capability maps with inheritance.
Implement hasPermission(identity, requiredPermission) evaluator.
acceptanceCriteria: Role hierarchy correctly resolves inherited capabilities.
SuperAdmin matches all wildcards (*).

tasks.name: Contextual ABAC Policy Engine
tasks.description: High-performance policy evaluator evaluating subject, resource, action, and environment (IP CIDR, time window, model rules).
implementationSteps: Implement PolicyEvaluationRequest and PolicyDecision schemas.
Implement IP CIDR subnet matching logic (IPv4/IPv6).
Implement time-window (UTC schedule) evaluator.
Evaluate allow/deny rules with explicit deny override.
acceptanceCriteria: Denies requests originating from disallowed CIDR blocks.
Enforces time-of-day restrictions accurately.
Returns structured PolicyDecision with reason and parameter clamps.

tasks.name: Model Governance & Parameter Clamps
tasks.description: Enforce model access control, ceilings on max_tokens and temperature, and provider data classification isolation.
implementationSteps: Implement model allowlist/denylist with wildcard globbing (e.g., claude-3-5*).
Implement parameter clampers for max_tokens and temperature.
Implement provider isolation rule preventing confidential data from routing to public free tiers.
acceptanceCriteria: Clamps max_tokens if requested value exceeds key ceiling.
Blocks unauthorized models with 403 Forbidden.

tasks.name: Unified AuthZ Middleware
tasks.description: Declarative route protection middleware for data plane (/v1/*) and control plane (/api/*).
implementationSteps: Extract requested action and resource from Hono request path and method.
Invoke policyEngine.evaluate().
Apply parameter clamps to request body if allowed.
Return 403 Forbidden with structured error if denied, triggering audit event.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthorized requests receive HTTP 403 with detailed reason code.
Authorized requests proceed with clamped parameters injected.

milestones.name: Consumer Accounting & Rate Limiting (AuthA Part 1)
milestones.description: Implement sliding-window RPM/TPM/concurrency rate limiting with RFC 6585 headers, atomic quota reservation wallet, and streaming SSE settlement.

tasks.name: Consumer Rate Limiter & RFC 6585 Headers
tasks.description: Sliding-window rate limiter tracking RPM, TPM, RPS, and in-flight concurrency, injecting RateLimit-* response headers.
implementationSteps: Implement sliding-window evaluation per consumer key, tenant, and IP.
Implement concurrency slot acquisition and release in request lifecycle.
Inject standard headers: RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset.
Return HTTP 429 with Retry-After when limits are exceeded.
acceptanceCriteria: Blocks requests exceeding RPM/TPM with HTTP 429.
Sets RFC 6585 and draft IETF rate limit headers accurately on all responses.
Concurrently tracks active in-flight requests without leaks.

tasks.name: Atomic Token Quota Manager
tasks.description: Pre-flight token estimation and atomic wallet hold, preventing concurrency balance overdrafts.
implementationSteps: Estimate prompt tokens and compute estimated pre-flight cost.
Execute atomic quota hold via storageBackend.reserveQuota().
Return HTTP 402 Payment Required if balance is insufficient.
Provide reconciliation method to settle actual cost vs held cost.
acceptanceCriteria: Rejects request with 402 when estimated cost exceeds wallet balance.
Atomically holds and releases quota without double-spending.

tasks.name: Streaming SSE Usage Settlement Hook
tasks.description: Instrument Hono stream writer to track chunk tokens in real-time, reconciling quota reservations on stream completion or abort.
implementationSteps: Wrap Hono SSE stream chunk writer.
Parse chunk deltas and accumulate token count.
On stream end or abort, invoke quotaManager.settle() with actual tokens.
Insert final record into request_logs table.
acceptanceCriteria: Stream chunks are delivered with zero added buffering latency.
Quota hold is reconciled immediately upon stream completion or client disconnect.

milestones.name: Immutable Audit Ledger & SIEM Export (AuthA Part 2)
milestones.description: Implement immutable security audit ledger with SHA-256 hash chaining, asynchronous buffer queue, and Syslog, OTel, and Webhook SIEM exporters.

tasks.name: Immutable Security Audit Ledger
tasks.description: Build immutable audit logging engine conforming to CloudEvents and RFC 5424 specifications with optional SHA-256 hash chaining.
implementationSteps: Implement buildAuditEvent() helper formatting actor, action, resource, clientInfo.
Implement cryptographic prevHash chaining to ensure tamper evidence.
Implement batch insert into audit_events database table.
Expose audit event query API with pagination and filter criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit records are immutable and contain time-sortable UUIDv7 IDs.
Tamper verification utility detects altered records.

tasks.name: Asynchronous Audit Buffer Queue
tasks.description: Zero-latency in-memory batching buffer queue with backpressure protection and periodic flushing to persistence and SIEM sinks.
implementationSteps: Implement in-memory ring buffer with configurable batch size and flush interval.
Implement backpressure dropping/spooling strategy under extreme load.
Handle process shutdown by flushing all pending events before exit.
acceptanceCriteria: Non-blocking dispatch introduces < 1ms overhead to gateway hot-path.
Flushes all pending events on SIGTERM / SIGINT signals.

tasks.name: Pluggable SIEM Exporters (Syslog, OTel, Webhook)
tasks.description: Implement pluggable compliance exporters for enterprise SIEM ingestion (RFC 5424 Syslog TLS/TCP/UDP, OTLP structured log, and signed HMAC webhooks).
implementationSteps: Implement RFC 5424 Syslog client supporting TLS, TCP, and UDP.
Implement OpenTelemetry structured log exporter using OTLP HTTP/JSON.
Implement Webhook exporter signing payload with HMAC-SHA256 and exponential backoff retry.
acceptanceCriteria: Syslog exporter produces valid RFC 5424 formatted messages.
Webhook deliveries include X-OpenClaw-Signature HMAC header.
Exporter failures do not affect gateway request processing.

milestones.name: Admin Management APIs, UI & Integration Suite
milestones.description: Implement /api/aaa/* administrative management REST endpoints, frontend React management views, and automated integration test suite.

tasks.name: Administrative REST APIs
tasks.description: Build Hono routes for tenant provisioning, hashed key administration, policy rules management, and audit log inspection.
implementationSteps: Implement CRUD routes for /api/aaa/tenants.
Implement key creation and revocation routes /api/aaa/keys.
Implement policy evaluation test and reload routes /api/aaa/policies.
Implement audit trail query route /api/aaa/audit-logs.
acceptanceCriteria: All endpoints guarded by RBAC permissions check.
Input validation schemas enforce required parameters.

tasks.name: Frontend Control Panel Views
tasks.description: Build React dashboard views for multi-tenant switching, secure API key generation wizard, and audit log compliance viewer.
implementationSteps: Create TenantSwitcher component in dashboard navbar.
Create KeyCreationWizard with scope selector and one-time secret display modal.
Create AuditLogs view with filterable table, JSON diff viewer, and export buttons.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend builds cleanly with npm run build --prefix frontend.
UI components handle loading, error, and empty states cleanly.

tasks.name: Automated AAA Integration Test Suite
tasks.description: Develop end-to-end integration test suite verifying AuthN, AuthZ, Rate Limiting, and Audit logging behaviors.
implementationSteps: Write tests for key generation, hashing, and authentication verification.
Write tests for RBAC role enforcement and ABAC CIDR/parameter clamps.
Write tests for sliding-window 429 rate limiting and RFC 6585 headers.
Write tests for audit log generation and tamper-evident hash chaining.
acceptanceCriteria: All tests execute against local SQLite and Memory storage with 100% pass rate.
Edge cases (expired keys, rate limits exceeded, invalid signatures) covered.
